newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani stocks end up before holidays.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani stocks end up before holidays.

text.p: Pakistani stocks closed slightly up on Wednesday amid covering of short positions before a four-day break for the Moslem festival of Eid al-Adha, dealers said.
"Covering of short positions helped the index resist the overall bearish sentiment," dealer Ali Asghar of Fortune Securities said.

The Karachi Stock Exchange 100-share index rose 3.51 points, or 0.23 percent, to close at 1,523.09. Losers led gainers 152 to 73. PTCL fell 0.10 to 26.70 rupees. Pakistan State Oil rose 2.0 to 275. -- Ovais Subhani 9221-5685192
